description: This Java source file defines the 'AnrParser' class, which is responsible for parsing 'Application Not Responding' (ANR) reports from logs generated on Android systems. It identifies specific patterns in the log lines to extract relevant ANR information such as process name, process ID, reason, CPU usage, and process snapshots, assembling these into data structures for further analysis.
